title: Daily Workout · October 24
note: 55 minutes. Walking intervals, glute strengthening and obliques. HOKA Clifton 9 or New Balance 1080v15 with loose midfoot laces if comfortable; stop if tingling returns. No Tai Chi.

items.name: Lying quad stretch
items.instructions: Lie on your side and gently draw your upper heel toward your glutes. Switch sides after 30 seconds.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit with soles together, let knees relax outward, and keep your spine comfortable.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Sit tall and rotate gently without forcing your lower back.

items.name: Plow Pose (Halasana)
items.detail: 1 minute including gentle entry and exit
items.instructions: Only use your comfortable established range; avoid forcing feet to floor or putting pressure on neck.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Walk comfortably and gradually increase speed.

items.name: Brisk walking interval
items.instructions: Walk briskly at a pace you can control; keep breathing comfortably.

items.name: Recovery walking interval
items.instructions: Ease back to a comfortable walking pace.

items.name: Cool-down

items.name: Glute bridges
items.instructions: Lie with knees bent, lift hips by squeezing glutes for 2 seconds at the top; avoid arching lower back. Rest as needed.

items.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlifts
items.instructions: Hold dumbbells, hinge at hips with soft knees and neutral back; stand by squeezing glutes. Use comfortable weight and range.

items.name: Resistance-band lateral steps
items.instructions: Keep knees slightly bent and hips level; step sideways against light band resistance, then return. Rest between sets.

items.name: Side planks
items.detail: 3 min · 2 × 30 sec each side with rest
items.instructions: Hold a straight body line on your forearm, switching sides and resting between holds. Modify with knees down if needed.

items.name: Suitcase carries
items.detail: 3 min · 2 × 30 sec each side with rest
items.instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your side and walk slowly without leaning. Switch hands; rest between carries.

items.name: Bent-knee leg raises
items.instructions: Lie on your back and slowly raise bent knees while keeping your lower back controlled. Stop if groin or back discomfort occurs.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Extend opposite arm and leg slowly while maintaining a neutral, controlled trunk.
